opportunities.name: Kick Ap Countercatch
opportunities.objective: Separate knockback mark and explosion hit reliability.
opportunities.mechanic: Q has 1.2 AP magic damage, AP-scaled slow and champion-hit mana refund. Mandate can use the first enemy knockback; AP also improves E shields and R healing. Rocketbelt tests approach angle while Horizon reveals a long-range bounce target rather than supplying unlisted damage amplification.
opportunities.requiredState: Ball knocks back the first champion and bounce explosion catches intended enemies.
opportunities.failure: AP income requirement loses support utility and unsafe positioning prevents Q.
opportunities.test: Separate knockback mark and explosion hit reliability; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Horizon reveal is not a damage multiplier in this catalog.

opportunities.name: Campfire Ally Reloads
opportunities.objective: Count P consumptions across campfire ticks and two E casts.
opportunities.mechanic: W reapplies P every three seconds during six seconds of range/heal support; P's initial packet scales with ally AD while burn has Milio AP. Staff/Helia and Dream Maker reward allied heals/shields, but P attribution and bubble consumption must be observed. E charges can maintain access after W expires.
opportunities.requiredState: Ally uses each granted P before refresh; record ally AD and support income.
opportunities.failure: Unspent P is overwritten or lack of enemy damage leaves Helia empty.
opportunities.test: Count P consumptions across campfire ticks and two E casts; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Building Milio AD does not amplify the ally-AD coefficient.

ruledOut.reason: P explicitly references ally Attack Damage, with Milio AP on the burn.

unknowns: Passive burn base is unresolved; ally damage ownership for Helia and timing of W passive reapplication need direct observation.
Unresolved conditional/runtime tooltip tokens prevent a complete numerical model; retained helpers do not establish live behavior.

testPlan: Required state: Ball knocks back the first champion and bounce explosion catches intended enemies.
Separate knockback mark and explosion hit reliability; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: AP income requirement loses support utility and unsafe positioning prevents Q.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Horizon reveal is not a damage multiplier in this catalog.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Hextech Rocketbelt, Imperial Mandate, Horizon Focus, Rabadon's Deathcap, Cryptbloom, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
Milio kicks a fireball, Knocking Back the first enemy hit. If it hits, the ball bounces past them and explodes, dealing [80 / 140 / 200 / 260 / 320 + (1.2) × AP] magic damage to surrounding enemies and Slowing them by [0.4 / 0.45 / 0.5 / 0.55 / 0.6 + (0.0005) × AP] for [1.5] seconds.

Hitting at least one enemy champion with {{Spell_MilioKickballQ_Name}} refunds [50]% of it's Mana cost.

Milio unleashes a wave of soothing flames on nearby ally champions, cleansing Disabling and Immobilizing effects, restoring [150 / 250 / 350 + (0.5) × AP] Health, and granting [65]% Tenacity for [3] seconds.

Milio wraps an ally champion in protective flames, granting [45 / 75 / 105 / 135 / 165 + (0.45) × AP] Shield and [(0.12 / 0.14 / 0.16 / 0.18 / 0.2) × 100]% Move Speed for [2.5] seconds.

This ability has 2 charges and the effects stack on repeat targets.
